description: Ethereum transaction check by hash: success or reverted, gas used, fee paid, confirmations, whether the block is finalized, and any ERC-20 transfers decoded from the receipt logs (token, from, to, amount). When to use: did this ETH or ERC-20 payment actually settle, is it irreversible, who paid whom and how much. Do not use: for fee estimation (eth_get_fee_rates) or for Tron (tron_get_transaction). Returns: found, status, block_number, from, to, value_eth, gas_used, fee_eth, confirmations, finalized, erc20_transfers[]. A miss is reported as absent from *our* node only - never as proof of non-existence.
name: eth_get_transaction
